narrative.overview:
The authenticated app is the category standard for a mobile management app, executed at full craft: a pale green-gray ground, white lifted cards, one green for action and selection, and red, amber and green only when a validity state exists. It is built for a phone held in one hand in a bright, busy kitchen and for the Arny AR-SP5 terminal (about 360 × 720 CSS px). Validity and emission are one tap away; the expiry date is always the most legible thing on the screen.

This document has three scopes. **Part A (primary system)** covers the authenticated workspace (`src/components/workspace/Workspace.tsx` and the panels it hosts), the login (`src/components/AuthLogin.tsx`, both the dialog and the full page) and the public QR consultation page (`src/routes/label.$token.tsx`), styled by `src/styles.css`. **Part B** preserves the public landing system (`src/components/landing/SystemLanding.tsx`, `src/landing.css`), which keeps its own neutrals and DM Sans section headings; its tokens carry the `landing-` prefix. **The thermal print label** (`.thermal-label`, Arial, 60 × 40 mm) is a print artifact outside both UI systems; its rules are fixed by the printer, not by this document.

The app has a dark theme (`.dark`) that remaps the same token names; the login always renders in the light tokens, even in dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: One family (Manrope) in a short scale; heavy, tight page titles; tabular numerals for every date and count.
White cards with a soft downward shadow on a green-gray ground; no decorative imagery.
Green means action or selection; red, amber and green tones mean a validity state and never decorate.
Bottom tab bar below 1024px, sidebar at 1024px and above; 44–56px touch targets throughout.
Lucide stroke icons always paired with text.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and state green appear only when a validity or status state exists, and always beside text that names it ("Vencidas", "Já venceu", "Vence hoje"). A count of zero falls back to `ink-soft`.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: `destructive` is the only red fill in the app; `bad-ink` is the red for text and icons on `bad-bg`. No other reds, and no Tailwind palette colors in place of the state pairs.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inside `.workspace-shell`, `.auth-dialog` and `.label-page`, `--font-display` resolves to Manrope; DM Sans belongs to the landing only.

rules.name: The Tabular Date Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, count and badge number uses tabular numerals so columns and countdowns never jitter.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: Primary navigation lives in the bottom bar on phones and the AR-SP5; nothing essential is hidden behind a top hamburger. Tabs are at least 56px tall; every other control at least 44px (inputs 46–48px, settlement choices 48–68px).

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse, downward and green-black at low opacity. No hard offset shadows and no heavy drop shadows on cards.

rules.name: The Functional Green Rule
rules.body: Use green for primary actions, selected controls, operational icons and concise heading emphasis. Reserve the amber pair for an attention status.

rules.name: The Existing Type Rule
rules.body: Use the existing Manrope and DM Sans families on the landing; retain the Manrope hero override and the inherited DM Sans section headings.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and pale tonal grounds for ordinary grouping; reserve soft shadows for the product container, selected tab and illustrative label.

dos: **Do** keep the expiry date the most legible element of any label, row or page, in tabular numerals.
**Do** use `brand-green` for the one primary action per view and for selection; keep everything else neutral.
**Do** pair every state color with text naming the state, and use the token pairs (`bad-*`, `warn-*`, `ok-*`).
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px minimum, 56px for tabs, and inputs at 16px on phones.
**Do** keep primary navigation in the bottom bar below 1024px and in the sidebar at 1024px and above.
**Do** put useful content in the first phone viewport and move secondary filters behind an on-demand control.
**Do** respect safe areas at the top and bottom, and `prefers-reduced-motion` (all transitions collapse).
Landing: **Do** preserve the white and green operational identity and established typography.
Landing: **Do** keep interactive controls at least 44px tall and show visible keyboard focus.
Landing: **Do** retain labels, text status explanations and explicit fictitious-data notices in the demonstration.
Landing: **Do** stack columns and reflow rows on small screens instead of squeezing the desktop layout.
donts: **Don't** use DM Sans or any second family inside the authenticated app, login or QR page.
**Don't** use red, amber or state green as decoration, or introduce a second red or Tailwind palette oranges and reds in place of the state tokens.
**Don't** use the shadcn amber `--accent` for states or hovers; it is not part of this system.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above page titles.
**Don't** add hard offset shadows or heavy drop shadows to cards.
**Don't** squeeze the desktop dashboard onto phones: no hidden top menus, oversized titles or filters filling the first screen.
**Don't** derive UI styling from the thermal print label, or print-label specs from the UI.
Landing: **Don't** introduce photography, olive colors, editorial serif faces or decorative background lettering into this landing.
Landing: **Don't** replace clear groups and dividers with a mosaic of promotional cards.
Landing: **Don't** use the illustrative label styling as a specification for physical printed labels.
